1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a plurality of precoders from a codebook in a transmitter having an antenna array; transforming each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q = p^H Z p with respect to the corresponding precoder p, where the quadratic form is based on a transmission line impedance of a transmission line between a signal source and the antenna array, __and wherein the quadratic form is derived from physical circuit parameters including at least one of the transmission line impedance, an impedance matrix of the antenna array, or a signal source impedance__; receiving a signal from the signal source; applying a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel; and transmitting the precoded signal.

2. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is also based on __at least one of: an impedance matrix of the antenna array, a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array, an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, or length of the transmission line__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by __normalizing each precoder by dividing each precoder by__ an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before [[scaling]] __normalization__ is applied.

6. (Currently amended) The method according to claim [[5]] __1__, wherein [[scaling]] __normalization__ comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form.

7. (Currently amended) The method according to claim [[5]] __1__, further comprising transmitting a scaling factor used for the [[scaling]] __normalization__.

8. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix __derived from circuit parameters of the transmission line and antenna array__ such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having the same power.

9. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 8, wherein the transformation matrix is based on __and derived from__ an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array.

10. (Original) The method according to claim 1, wherein the transformation equalizes the transmit power for all of the plurality of precoders.

11. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein transforming transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders __where the energy is defined by the quadratic form__ when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array.

12. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein both data symbol precoders and reference symbol precoders are transformed by the same transformation __derived from the same quadratic form__.

13. (Original) The method according to claim 12, further comprising: receiving a precoded signal including reference symbols; estimating channels for the reference symbols; estimating a channel for the data symbols by taking an inner product of a conjugate of a data symbol precoder and the reference symbol channel estimates; and demodulating received data symbols based on the estimated channel.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: an antenna array; a transceiver coupled to the antenna array; a signal source coupled to the transceiver; a transmission line coupled between the signal source and the antenna array, the transmission line having a transmission line impedance; a memory to store a codebook including a plurality of precoders; and a controller coupled to the transceiver and the memory, the controller configured to: receive a plurality of precoders from the codebook, transform each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q = p^H Z p with respect to the corresponding precoder p, __where the quadratic form is derived from physical circuit parameters including at least one of the transmission line impedance, an impedance matrix of the antenna array, or a signal source impedance__, receive a signal from the signal source, and apply a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel, wherein the transceiver transmits the precoded signal.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the quadratic form is also based on __at least one of: an impedance matrix of the antenna array, a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array, an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, or length of the transmission line__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by __normalizing each precoder by dividing each precoder by__ an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before [[scaling]] __normalization__ is applied.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 16, wherein [[scaling]] __normalization__ comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix __derived from circuit parameters of the transmission line and antenna array__ such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having the same power.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 18, wherein the transformation matrix is based on __and derived from__ an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the controller transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders __where the energy is defined by the quadratic form__ when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array.
